description: This file defines a class CreateReportScheduleCommand for creating and validating report schedules in the Superset project, including handling recipients, validation of report properties, and interaction with DAOs.

classes.name: CreateReportScheduleCommand
classes.description: A command class for creating and validating report schedules, handling recipient population, validation, and database interactions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with report schedule data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the creation of a report schedule within a transaction, raising an error if creation fails.

methods.name: _populate_recipients
methods.description: Populates report recipients based on creation method and current user, raising error if user email is missing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates report schedule properties, including uniqueness, relations, frequency, and extra configurations.

methods.name: _validate_report_extra
methods.description: Validates the 'extra' configuration of the report schedule, especially related to dashboard tabs and anchors.
